messages:
mel: quick check — I need a facilitator swap for next week's archboard. I'm out Tues morning. Can someone take the opening slot? :wave:
ranjit: I can grab it if nobody else has picked it up. what’s the agenda like?
sam: +1 ranjit for facil. i can cover the last triage item if needed. :thumbsup:
dena: thanks — if ranjit takes lead can we shorten the RFC slot to 20m? there's one longer design review in the backlog.
mel: yes — thinking compact agenda. draft below, feel free to edit inline.
mel: ```
Agenda (45m):
1) Roll call / quick updates (5m)
2) RFC: distributed KV cache eviction (20m) - @jules pre-read linked
3) Platform standards short-list (10m) - quant & batching guidance
4) Triage: recent tail latency alerts (10m)
Notes: keep watch for timeboxing, prefer A/B for followups.
```
jules: FYI the RFC link: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/564 — pre-read has perf numbers. i’ll be there but not presenting.
ranjit: happy to timebox. can we move the triage after standards if there’s churn? otherwise we’ll run late.
sam: if ranjit is facilitating i’ll take the triage and surface the 2 infra alerts i saw this morning.
dena: small ask — add a 2min lightning slot at top to surface blockers from platform teams. helps triage.
mel: done — inserted lightning blockers as item 1a. ranjit if you want i can post the updated calendar invite now.
ranjit: please do that, and set the recording on. also set dial-in so the security folks can hop in.
mel: @calendar-bot schedule updated: 1709998888 -> Wed 09:30 PT, 45m, recording on (reacts :white_check_mark:)
infra-bot: Reminder: please attach any slide decks to the meeting thread 24h before start.
mel: noted — pushing slides link in channel tomorrow. thanks everyone — ranjit i'll DM a quick facil checklist. :hand:
ranjit: cheers — i’ll prepare time cues, will ping if we need to shuffle presenters.
